title: Paginate all PocketBase list fetches — never assume one page covers all records
body: PocketBase returns at most perPage records per request (default 200). When task volume exceeds that limit, unfetched tasks are silently skipped. Always check totalItems in the response and issue follow-up requests with page=2, page=3, etc.
source_ref: rules.md:R29; lessons — 'PocketBase Pagination and Task Volume: total may exceed perPage (e.g., 721 tasks found)'
